standard.summary: within_epoch_free_fit 模式下，每个样本可参与训练的分辨率 profile 数量。默认 2，取值被夹在 [2, 活跃 profile 总数]。
standard.effect: 值越大同一样本会以更多不同分辨率被训练到，多尺度覆盖更充分；后端把请求值 clamp 到实际可用 profile 数，不会超配。
standard.whenToUse: 多尺度泛化是目标（如同一 LoRA 要在 512~1536 都表现好）时调到 3~4；默认 2 已能兼顾成本与覆盖。
standard.avoidWhen: mixed_resolution_strategy 不是 within_epoch_free_fit 时无效；活跃 profile 少于 2 个时 free-fit 本身无法启用（后端报错）。

standard_en.summary: In within_epoch_free_fit mode, how many resolution profiles each sample may be trained at. The default is 2, and the value is clamped to [2, the total number of active profiles].
standard_en.effect: The larger the value, the more different resolutions the same sample gets trained at and the fuller the multi-scale coverage; the backend clamps the requested value to the number of profiles actually available, so it cannot be over-provisioned.
standard_en.whenToUse: Raise it to 3~4 when multi-scale generalisation is the goal (one LoRA that has to perform from 512 to 1536, say); the default 2 already balances cost against coverage.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has no effect unless mixed_resolution_strategy is within_epoch_free_fit; with fewer than 2 active profiles free-fit cannot be enabled at all (the backend errors out).

advanced.principle: free-fit 缓存为每个样本预编码多个分辨率 profile 的 latent；本键决定训练时每样本轮换使用的档位子集大小，等价于按样本粒度做多尺度数据增强，epoch 有效样本量随之放大。
advanced.expectedImpact: 档位数越多每 epoch 遍历成本越高（同一样本多次出现）；多尺度一致性提升。
advanced.tradeoffs: 缓存体积随 profile 数增长；档位过多时单一分辨率的有效步数被稀释。

advanced_en.principle: The free-fit cache pre-encodes latents at multiple resolution profiles per sample; this key decides how large a subset of profiles each sample cycles through during training — effectively multi-scale data augmentation at per-sample granularity, amplifying the epoch's effective sample count.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: More profiles raise per-epoch traversal cost (the same sample appears multiple times); multi-scale consistency improves.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Cache size grows with the profile count; too many profiles dilute the effective step count at any single resolution.
